report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94 ms durations; logs show only INFO 200s and metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~98 ms. No error, latency, pool, Redis timeout, or memory signal supports any taxonomy cause. The alert reflects healthy behavior, so no bounded root cause is established; hand off for operator clarification.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency/error SLO for /v1/checkout to judge whether 63-94 ms is anomalous
Evidence of failing or slow requests (non-200 statuses, timeouts, elevated p95/p99) during the window
Dependency-level metrics for order, inventory, payment, redis, postgres to test downstream latency
Connection pool saturation or Redis timeout telemetry if pool/redis causes are suspected
